content: गन्धः [गन्ध्-पचाद्यच्] .²1 Smell, odour; गन्धमाघ्राय चोर्व्याः <ls>Me. 21</ls>; अपघ्नन्तो दुरितं हव्यगन्धैः <ls>Ś. 4. 8</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 27</ls>. (गन्ध is changed to गन्धि when as the last member of a <ab>Bah. comp.</ab> it is preceded by उद्, पूति, सु, सुरभि, or when the compound implies comparison; सुगन्धि, सुरभिगन्धि, कमलगन्धि मुखम्; शालिनिर्यासगन्धिभिः <ls>R. 1. 38</ls>; आहुति˚ <ls n="R.">1. 53</ls>; also when गन्ध is used in the sense of ‘a little’). .²2 Smell considered as one of the 24 properties or guṇas of the Vaiśeṣikas; it is a property characteristic of पृथिवी or earth which is defined as गन्धवती पृथ्वी <ls>T. S.</ls> .²3 The mere smell of anything, a little, a very small quantity; घृतगन्धि भोजनम् <ls>Sk.</ls> .²4 A perfume, any fragrant substance; एषा मया सेविता गन्धयुक्तिः <ls>Mk. 8</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 231</ls>; <ls>Mu. 1. 4</ls>. .²5 Sulphur. .²6 Pounded sandalwood. .²7 Connection, relationship. .²8 A neighbour. .²9 Pride, arrogance; as in आत्तगन्ध humbled or mortified. .²10 An epithet of Śiva. .²11 A sectarial mark on the forehead. .²12 Similarity (सादृश्य); डुण्डुभानहिगन्धेन न त्वं हिंसितुमर्हसि <ls>Mb. 1. 10. 3</ls>. .{@-न्धम्@} .²1 Smell. .²2 Black aloe-wood.
